about: [C13] a teach card never shows under a chapter card (lane C10a's frame a05: [LMB] fire faint under VII PIER NINE, VII's loud pass begun cold): the card's own 0.7 s fade included, the kit holds the teach unseen until the chapter card has gone, then it comes. Sampled every 30 ms. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/c13_card_teach.json

steps.eval: (window.__over = [], window.__cardSeen = 0, setInterval(() => { const H = G.hud, ch = H.el.chapter, te = H.kit.teachEl; const cardOn = ch.style.display !== 'none' && parseFloat(ch.style.opacity || '0') > 0.01; const teachOn = te.style.display !== 'none' && parseFloat(te.style.opacity || '0') > 0.01 && getComputedStyle(te).visibility !== 'hidden'; if (cardOn) window.__cardSeen++; if (cardOn && teachOn) window.__over.push({ t: +G.time.toFixed(2), card: +parseFloat(ch.style.opacity).toFixed(2), teach: +parseFloat(te.style.opacity).toFixed(2), id: H.kit.teachCur && H.kit.teachCur.id }); }, 30), 1)
JSON.stringify({ over: window.__over.slice(0, 5), n: window.__over.length, cardSamples: window.__cardSeen })
